basic_info.main_problem: 倾向将一次失败灾难化,视作整体失败,导致压力和Anxiety显著升高;该认知模式在学业与Work中反复出现,并影响Work表现,Interpersonal relationships与日常自我照料.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes that catastrophizing and extreme thinking are harming mental health and work performance; seeks counseling to challenge and adjust these cognitive patterns.
growth_experiences: 这些灾难化与极端思维的倾向始于求学阶段的学业挑战;在学业中自我期望很高,Failing one exam即被视为整体失败,逐步形成以完美主义应对的习惯(追求所有任务的完美),此后延续至职业阶段并加重压力与Anxiety.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pursues perfection in all tasks to make up for failure

object_relations.object_representation: not够优秀,需要被区分的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Student在课堂上表现困难或Teacher评估分数偏低时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的困难与外部反馈理解为对自身整体能力的negate(移情:把当前情境等同于过去学业失败的羞耻经历)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责语气反复强调'It is all my fault',降低对事实证据的探究,忽略积极反馈;语调低落,少用开放式探询.

manifestations: 以Introjection的外界标准作为自我价值条件('必须/应该完美')
将一次失败视为整体negate,选择被外部评价束缚的生活方式

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes elite-school and high-score standards as the sole scale of worth
A single exam failure leads to concluding 'the whole semester is ruined'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 课堂上遇到Studentnot理解即迅速Self-doubt
Overly focuses on evaluation scores and defines the self by them
将外界困难过度Interpretation为'我not行'

exception_events.target_problem: 在Student表现困难或Teacher评估偏低的情境下,来访者通常会灾难化并自责,随后出现高Anxiety,Sleep and diet affected.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在一次课堂中,有Student对一节课给予积极反馈并取得好成绩;当时来访者have not陷入'I am a failure'的旧反应,而是短暂体验到自我效能与成就感,Anxiety明显减弱.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:获得即时的Student正向反馈;not同理解:看到具体证据反驳'单次挫折=整体失败'的信念,从而短暂允许积极体验.

positive_force: Willing to do structured recording and behavioral experiments
Has emotional support from a few colleagues and friends
曾获得Student的正向反馈与教学成功经验
Can proactively adjust teaching methods and provide extra support
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization are significant
Excessive self-blame and personalizing external problems
Ignores positive evidence and positive feedback (mental filtering)

target_behavior.core_reason: 求学阶段形成的高期待与精英化标准被Introjection,导致将单次挫折视为整体失败,并把外部问题个人化到自身能力与价值上.
target_behavior.function: 通过自责与完美主义维持对局势的主观控制感,试图避免被批评与再次失败带来的Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet affected,Decline in work performance,Interpersonal tension,压力与Anxiety持续升高
